1.The aforementioned consolidated financial results were reviewed by the Audit Committees and approved by the Board of Directors at the respective meetings held on 26th May, 2025.

3 The Board of Directors of the Holding Company have recommended a Dividend of 30 % (Le Rs.1.50'- per equity shares (Previous Year- 30% (i.e. Rs.1.50'- per equity share)

4 These consolidated financial results have been prepared in accordance with Indian Accounting Standards (Ind AS), prescribed under section 133 of the Companies Act, 2013 read with Rule 3 of the Companies (In ‘Accounting Standards) Rule, 2015 and relevant amendments thereafter.

5 On November 21, 2025, the Government of India notified the four Labour Codes - Code on Wages, 2019, e industrial Relations Code, 2020, the Coda on Socal Security, 2020, and the Occupational Safety, Health and Working Conditions Code, 2020 - consolidating 29 existing labor laws. The Ministry of Labour & Employment published draft Contral Rules and FAQs 10 enable assessment of the financial impact due to changes in regulations. The Group has assessed impact of these changes on the basis of the best information available consistent with the guidance provided by the Institute of Chartered Accountants of Inda and noted that the material impact of the said codes, However, the Group continues to monitor the finalization of Central / State Rules and clarifications from the Government on other aspects of the Labour Code and shall review is estimates and assumptions on ongoing basis.

6. The Group's business activity falls within & single reportable operating segment, "Writing Instruments and Stationery”, hence has only one reportable operating segment as per IND AS 108-Operating Segments.

7 The Holding company had received a demand order dated January 31, 2025 towards short payment of Goods & Services Tax ('GST?) amounting Lo Rs.353.36 lakhs and Penalty amounting to Rs 353,39 akhs plus applicable interest with respect of HSN classifications pen refill and other components. The company has contested tis demand, fling an appeal against the order on March 23, 2025, Based on advice from
taxation expert, the Holding Company believes that it has strong case on merits and hence no provision has been made there against.
